title: Octy's More Discs
description: Yet another mod that add more discs
body:
This mod adds a blank music disc and 23 new music discs.

Features:

- 1 blank disc (crafted with 8 flint and 1 redstone dust)\
- 23 custom and craftable music discs\
- A _/credits_ command that shows music credits in the chat for the music that need credits

**Important : I DO NOT OWN ANY OF THE SONGS USED !**
